purpose: Let each user evaluate eligible AI models with frontier, efficiency, comparison, or hybrid strategies.

frontier.name: U.S. Frontier Mode
frontier.strategy: high-compute search, parallel candidates, RL/RLVR, tool-use and extended test-time compute

efficiency.name: Efficiency Mode
efficiency.strategy: resource-aware RL, GRPO experiments, selective distillation, adaptive reasoning budgets and compact retrieval

compare.name: Compare Mode
compare.strategy: run both strategies under controlled benchmark conditions and compare evidence

hybrid.name: Hybrid Mode
hybrid.strategy: select strategies conditionally using benchmark evidence and resource budgets

promotion: Only evidence-backed improvements with acceptable safety and regression results may be promoted.
licensing: Respect each model, dataset, and artifact license; do not label restricted materials as open source.
scale: Model and capability counts are inventory values, never architectural limits.
